correctness.rationale: Four-chart Jacobian unit-ideal checks over F2 rigorously certify geometric smoothness for all 511 coefficient vectors, giving 144 smooth divisors. An independent F16 point test with an extension-completeness argument confirms the same set. Additive finite enumeration proves exactly 804 pencils and absence of nets; two independent finite group actions yield 13 orbits. All 804 chartwise Jacobian-minor ideals are unit ideals, so the degree-eight base intersections are reduced. Exact F_(2^d) point counts for d=1..8 and divisor-sum inversion prove the five Frobenius partitions. Two delivered programs and saved stdout provide replay.

value.rationale: This is the entire natural minimal-degree genus-one family on the smallest split quadric with all rational members smooth, rather than an arbitrarily sliced statistic. Its maximal projective dimension, 13 orbit types and five Frobenius base cycles are precise arithmetic-geometric constraints not implied by the general existence theorem or abstract elliptic curve point counts. The unique orbit with an irreducible degree-eight base is a distinguished structural extremum.
